stories.title: Bilawal urges Achakzai to use ‘authority’ delegated by Imran, asks opposition to play role in Parliament
stories.brief: Turning to Achakzai, Bilawal urged the opposition leader to use the “authority and power” delegated to him and the Senate opposition leader by Imran Khan to direct opposition members to participate in committee proceedings and discuss pressing national issues.

stories.title: Bilawal urges opposition to resume participation in committees, implores Achakzai to use 'authority' granted by Imran
stories.brief: Bilawal stressed that participation in parliamentary committees would help address the opposition’s fundamental concern of election rigging.

stories.title: Elon Musk is a 'real genius', Putin says after satellite talks with SpaceX boss
stories.brief: The Russian President praised Musk and said they are in "close" contact.

stories.title: Building boom puts 300,000 people in the path of potential Himalayan disasters
stories.brief: The construction of tourism facilities, housing, and infrastructure has surged in parts of Nepal and India's Uttarakhand.

stories.title: ATC sentences Imaan, Hadi to 10 years in security breach case
stories.brief: ISLAMABAD: An anti-terrorism court on Thursday sentenced human rights lawyer Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha, to 10 years in prison each in the security breach case.

stories.title: Pakistan, Turkiye have matured historic friendship into 'multifaceted strategic partnership': PM Shehbaz
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday said that Pakistan and Turkiye had transformed their historic ties into a "multifaceted strategic partnership", while stressing the need for stronger economic cooperation, investment and joint ventures between the two countries.

stories.title: PTI, TTAP affirm 'full support' for Fazl after govt hammering in Parliament
stories.brief: During today's NA session, Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi and Defence Minister Khawaja Asif unleashed a barrage of criticism on the JUI-F chief for remarks about Asif's absence from talks in Tehran, saying no defence agreement was being negotiated there.

stories.title: QatarEnergy buys US, other LNG to hedge future Hormuz disruptions
stories.brief: QatarEnergy is buying long-term supplies of liquefied natural gas from the US and other ​producers as part of a trading strategy designed to generate revenue if exports through the Strait of Hormuz are disrupted in the future, CEO Saad Sherida Al-Kaabi told Reuters on Thursday.

stories.title: PTI throws weight behind suspended K-P chief minister, says Afridi has Imran’s backing
stories.brief: The Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) on Thursday ruled out any change in the office of the Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) chief minister, reaffirming that Sohail Afridi would continue to hold the position with the support of party founder Imran Khan.

stories.title: Govt will try to ensure Noreen’s relatives can visit her, Rana Sanaullah says
stories.brief: Speaking about Noreen’s health, Sanaullah said she had been transferred to hospital for treatment immediately after she complained of poor health. Addressing concerns over the facilities available to Imran in custody, Sanaullah said reports on the ground situation, including amenities, food and other services, had been submitted to the Supreme Court.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz approves expansion of Karachi, Lahore airports
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday approved the expansion of Karachi and Lahore airports under their respective master plans, directing authorities to complete the projects within the stipulated timelines and ensure compliance with international standards.

stories.title: Manchester United’s Carrick backs Fernandes and is expected to face Chelsea
stories.brief: Michael Carrick will manage Man Utd at Chelsea on Saturday despite sacking rumours and says Bruno Fernandes will return.

stories.title: Europe’s central bank chief, Christine Lagarde, steps down for ‘freedom of speech’
stories.brief: Possible candidate to run World Economic Forum departs ECB nine months early, saying she wants to speak her mind about world affairsChristine Lagarde, the eurozone’s top central banker, has said she is stepping down nine months early to speak her mind about world affairs and confront the “misrepresentation of the truth”.Ending months of speculation about…

stories.title: Your pay, energy bills and savings: How the Budget affects you
stories.brief: Changes announced by Chancellor John Healey in his first Budget will affect your finances directly.

stories.title: 'I live with a ghost' - inside the haunted homes attracting bargain hunters
stories.brief: Properties where someone has died in tragic circumstances can have big reductions in price.

stories.title: Hello Kitty company cuts ties with Japanese spy show after China outcry
stories.brief: Sanrio ends association with TV drama Vivant after China says portrayal of ruthless Chinese agents is ‘deliberate smear’The company behind the successful Hello Kitty franchise has apologised and ended its commercial tie-up with a Japanese TV drama after Chinese state media and netizens condemned the show’s “deliberate smears” against China.Sanrio, a Japanese firm whose characters…

stories.title: Hello Kitty maker cuts ties with Japanese spy drama after China backlash
stories.brief: Sanrio has apologised after its merchandise line with Japanese TV series Vivant drew criticism.

stories.title: Details of thousands of US immigration agents leaked in major hack
stories.brief: A group called the Department of Peace released information on more than 41,000 DHS staff.

stories.title: Microsoft profits soar days after announcing thousands of layoffs
stories.brief: The week, the Windows developer said it would offer buyouts to 60,000 workers as it looks to curb costs.

stories.title: 'Not related to defence': Govt responds to Fazl's remarks about Makkah pact countries' meeting in Tehran
stories.brief: Federal ministers on Thursday responded to Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl (JUI-F) chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman’s remarks regarding a recent huddle in Tehran comprising the Makkah defence pact countries and Iran.
